name: Odik II
description: Odik II was a planet that was located on the Byss Run hyperlane in the Deep Core. It housed political detention wards used by the Galactic Empire to secretly imprison many dissidents. The Human officer Major Calders served at the detention facility before being reassigned aboard the Imperial Death Star battle station.
